title: Director/Assistant Director, The President's Own, U.S. Marine Band (II) (Col to 1stLt) PMOS, DIR USMB
raw_text:
2. MOS 5505, Director/Assistant Director, The President's Own, U.S. Marine
Band (II) (Col to 1stLt) PMOS, DIR USMB

    a. Summary. MOS 5505 is assigned to those officers designated by the
Secretary of the Navy to command or assist in commanding "The President's
Own" U.S. Marine Band in providing music and performing such other functions
as are directed by the President of the United States and the Commandant of
the Marine Corps.

       b.   Prerequisites

            (1) Must have the recommendation of the Director, U.S. Marine Band.

        (2) Security requirement:       top secret security clearance eligibility
(category II White House access).

        (3) Must meet eligibility and appointment criteria as prescribed in
MCO 1040.42B, WO and LDO accession programs.

    c. Requirements. Designation by the Secretary of the Navy, pursuant to
the provisions of reference (ab), Chapter 6222, Title 10, U.S. Code.

       d.   Duties

            (1) Serves as Commanding Officer of the U.S. Marine Band.

        (2) Serves as musical advisor to the President of the United States,
the White House, and the Commandant of the Marine Corps.

        (3) Serves as principal conductor of the U.S. Marine Band and White
House Chamber Orchestra and ensures professional quality musical performance,
to include program selection and preparation.

        (4) Ensures direct liaison is maintained with the Commanding
Officer, Marine Barracks Washington, DC regarding U.S. Marine Band
administrative and logistical matters.

        (5) Ensures direct liaison is maintained with the White House for
purposes of scheduling U.S. Marine Band presidential support commitments.

         (6) Ensures direct liaison is maintained with the Director,
Communication Directorate, HQMC, regarding all U.S. Marine Band operational
matters.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Music Directors and Composers 27-2041.

       f.   Related Military Skill.   None.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
